style.backgroundSystem: flat #A8BCD6 studio fields carrying a vertical fluted wall relief, solid #2E4B7E block cards with 24px corners, one #6E7CF3 into #C7CEF9 cobalt-violet gradient atmosphere field and clean #FFFFFF copy bands alternating screen by screen, matte #EDEFF2 floor for the photographic screens
style.direction: cool clinical pet parasiticide care detail-page ecommerce
style.iconSystem: gold-rim #E8B579 medallions holding one flat generic animal silhouette in #2E4B7E on ivory #F5EFE6; solid #F2762E dot badges carrying #FFFFFF captions; hairline arc connectors in #FFFFFF; thin double-quote marks, oversized sequence numerals in #C6D2E2 and one short dash rule under every heading
style.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light, front-left key at 6000K with bounce fill, low contrast, gentle rim on the bottle shoulder, soft contact shadows that ground every object, one diffused ring glow as the only decorative light, never hard speculars and never floating products
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium pet parasiticide-care ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of field #A8BCD6, block #2E4B7E, gradient cobalt #6E7CF3, card #FFFFFF, surface #EDEFF2, ivory pack body #F5EFE6, one gold accent #E8B579, one bright orange badge accent #F2762E and one rose-gold rim #D9A47C with charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool tone throughout; one modern geometric Chinese sans-serif family, display headlines in #2E4B7E on light fields, in #FFFFFF on #2E4B7E and gradient fields and in #2D2D2D on #FFFFFF, solid pill sub-banners and hairline kicker lines; layout system of solid pill sub-banners, one short dash rule under every heading, hairline arc connectors and raised #2E4B7E block cards with 24px corners; icon system of gold-rim #E8B579 medallions holding a flat generic animal silhouette in #2E4B7E on ivory #F5EFE6 plus solid #F2762E dot badges with #FFFFFF captions; cool soft studio light with a front-left key at 6000K, bounce fill, low contrast, gentle rim on the bottle shoulder and soft contact shadows only; backgrounds alternate between flat #A8BCD6 studio fields with a fluted wall relief, solid #2E4B7E block cards, a #6E7CF3 into #C7CEF9 gradient and clean #FFFFFF copy bands; round ivory pedestal in #F5EFE6 with a rose-gold rim band #D9A47C and a matte light-grey floor #EDEFF2; the bottle held upright at one consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale, grounded by a contact shadow, twin bottles only on the opening and closing screens, animals generic and cropped so no individual identity reads; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warm cream or oak drift, no cartoon pastel drift, no medical iconography beyond the emblem already printed on the label.
noDrift: no warm cream, kraft or oak styling drift
no cute cartoon pastel pet drift
no extra medical iconography such as crosses, shields, checkmark seals or organ diagrams beyond what is already printed on the label
no visible dose markers, syringes, QR codes, serial numbers or store membership badges
style.presentationRules: bottle always at the same slight 3/4 hero angle and scale on a #F5EFE6 field, single unit per screen except the opening and closing twin-pair screens, contact shadow mandatory, cap rings and label emblem readable, never cropped at the label panel, animals always generic and cropped at the shoulders or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable
style.surfaceSystem: round ivory display pedestal in #F5EFE6 edged by a rose-gold rim band #D9A47C, matte light-grey floor #EDEFF2, dark charcoal card surface #2D2D2D for the scope screen, pale grey studio card #EDEFF2 for the numbered list screen
style.typography: one modern geometric Chinese sans-serif family; display headlines 30-48pt in #2E4B7E on light fields and in #FFFFFF on #2E4B7E and gradient fields, in #2D2D2D on #FFFFFF; solid pill sub-banners 16-20pt, hairline kicker 14pt, labels 14-18pt; every visible string is a placeholder, no dense body copy
